hypothesis: Validation-safe checkpoint averaging over the strongest single-run FM+BPR trajectory can confirm whether residual epoch-selection noise is still leaving a small amount of single-run performance on the table. The expected gain is modest and only relevant for a single model (not multi-seed ensembles), but this benchmark scores one trained run per node, so averaging a few selected checkpoints from the incumbent training path is a direct confirmation of that measured pipeline-level effect.
